name: Eisengießerei Velkenreith GmbH
summary: Velkenreith is a family-owned iron foundry founded in 1936, with 240 staff, 34.2 M EUR turnover and sound finances (equity 38.5 %, credit index steady at 239). It is our sole source for Impeller HN 250 and supplies 70 % of HN 200, yet we are only 1.4 % of its turnover. The owner recently reminded us of the favour he did us in 2022 and expects partnership in return, while its delivery performance has slid from green to amber.

situation.decision_maker: owner (visits personally and frames the relationship); day-to-day sales via new inside-sales contact since 2025-10-01

negotiation_pattern: Asks for small moves (-4.1 % to +3.2 %) and always settles 1.4 to 4 points below its ask. On HN 250 it accepted 0.0 % twice despite asking +2.0 % and +3.2 %. On HN 200 it repeatedly 'accepted below full cost to keep the volume', most recently asking +2.6 % and settling at -1.4 %. It quoted HN 200 at 37.90 in the 2025 RFQ, and the current price is 34.26. It yields to pressure but keeps score: the owner now expects reciprocity for 2022.
wants: recognition and partnership (reciprocity for holding prices in 2022)
long-term volume security and contract continuity
a fair shot at new business (HX volute casing, 4,200 pc/yr from 03/2027)
being paid on time (we pay late 90 % of the time, about 6 days)
relief on HN 200, priced below our estimated cost
protects: unit_price on HN 200: already at -4.8 % vs no-margin should-cost, little room left
unit_price on HN 250: held at 0.0 % for two years, it will resist cuts
dignity and goodwill: will dig in against threats or benchmark pressure

trades.give: contract_months: extend the framework 24-36 months instead of the tacit 12-month rollover
trades.get: unit_price hold for 2027 on both impellers plus a written OTD recovery plan toward the 95 % target
trades.why: Long-term commitment is the currency a family firm values most; it buys price stability and delivery fixes.

trades.give: payment_days: commit to actually paying on the 45-day net term (or 30 days)
trades.get: unit_price hold on HN 250 and a lead_time_days commitment of 49 days or less
trades.why: Our chronic late payment undercuts any partnership claim; paying on time is a cheap respect signal.

trades.give: volume_per_year: firm forecast and quota security on HN 200 (keep 70 %), plus serious consideration in the HX volute RFQ
trades.get: ppm_commitment below 700 and closure of the 2 open 8Ds, with the chargeback kept at EUR 150
trades.why: It has repeatedly traded price for volume; new series volume is the strongest carrot we have.

trades.give: unit_price: no further reduction demand on HN 200
trades.get: a supply-security and capacity commitment on sole-source HN 250
trades.why: Squeezing a below-cost part risks walk-away; securing the sole-source part matters more.

arguments.point: We remember that you held prices for a quarter in 2022. We want to return that with a longer agreement and a fair chance on HX, in exchange for stability on price and delivery.
Our business with you grew every year (375k, then 433k, then 488k EUR); we want to keep growing it together.
OTD fell from 89.6 % to 74.5 % against the 95 % contract target. Fixing this is the precondition for new series volume.

avoid: threats or naming Tarsevi as a lever; the owner reacts to disrespect, not pressure
demanding another price cut on HN 200, which is already below our cost estimate
presenting the should-cost as hard fact (confidence only 5 %)
pushing chargebacks hard while we ourselves pay late
tone: Personal, respectful and long-term. Address the owner's partnership expectation explicitly and be firm but factual on delivery performance.
red_flags: Sole source on HN 250 (100 % quota, no other sources). The tooling is ours, but there is no qualified alternative.
OTD is deteriorating (89.6 → 74.5 %, amber, class B) while received volume rises. This may signal a capacity strain we cannot confirm.
2 open 8D reports. The last complaint was 2026-09-04, and only 750 EUR has been recharged.
Repeated below-cost pricing on HN 200 is unsustainable and risks a sudden increase demand, quality slippage or walk-away.
Contract notice and price-change deadline is 90 days before 2026-12-31, i.e. about 2026-10-02. This is imminent and must be checked.
Our 1.4 % share gives us little leverage; the firm could deprioritise us.

evidence.claim: Family-owned, founded 1936, equity 38.5 %, credit index 239 unchanged over 12 months
Owner visited and invoked the 2022 price hold, expecting partnership
HN 200 price of 34.26 is 4.8 % below the no-margin should-cost of 35.98 (low confidence)
Has repeatedly accepted below full cost on HN 200 to keep the volume
HN 250 settled at 0.0 % in both of the last two renewals
OTD dropped to 74.5 % vs the 95 % target; ppm 734; score 83.6 amber
Framework runs to 2026-12-31 with 12-month auto-extension and 90-day notice; prices fixed per calendar year
Invited alongside Tarsevi to quote the new HX volute casing, 4,200 pc/yr, SOP March 2027
Quoted HN 200 at 37.90 with a 55-day lead time in the 2025 RFQ
